name: nwks-encounter-site
description: Recovered redesign concept for **nwksencounter.com** (Northwest Kansas Encounter — Men's Encounter / Women's Encounter). This is the "Animated Gateway" concept we built as a Claude Artifact and iterated on.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name nwks-encounter-site --branch main
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.photos.config.ts
scripts.test:api: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.photos.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply nwks-encounter
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply nwks-encounter --local
